variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.body: The union {name} has called a strike. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: A call to withhold labour
variants.body: A strike has been called by the union {name}. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: Work becomes the subject of a strike call
variants.body: The union {name} has issued a call for strike action. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.
